_note: GAME-07, LVL-02a. Generic pickup kinds. health: this kind. shift: metres the blob hops out with. Distances in metres, times in seconds.

health._note: A finisher sprays count blobs of amount health each. They hop out, settle, and bob. collectRadius: collected within this of the feet. attractRadius: closer than this (and the player not full health) they drift to the player at attractSpeed. max: live blobs across the whole level, the oldest first. lifetime: seconds before a blob dissolves.

ammo._note: LVL-02a. The foam ammo box the level files place (a pickups entry of a darts-* type). It sits on the floor (no hop), turns slowly and bobs, size is the box edge in metres, and a player within collectRadius of it collects it. The dart count comes from the level file's count field. lifetime 0: level boxes never expire. turnRate: radians per second.
